notes.title: Drag It v0.4.0 New Content
notes.notes:
[h1]Currently in Development Version v0.4[/h1]
[h2][b]Update Content: Added Hat Equipment[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503566/6213a5c5397bad5fc5dc2e94d8d0bb0a29bca26d.gif[/img]

[h3]When monsters spawn, there is a small chance they will be wearing a hat. Defeating them will cause a hat to drop. Hats have armor value and various attributes, divided into three quality levels (Common, Excellent, Rare)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503566/2aab4a1b7abd8402efce4498d3ebff9b964ee920.gif[/img]

[h3]Each armor value can completely block one instance of damage (ignoring the monster’s damage value). Once the armor value is depleted, the hat is destroyed.[/h3]

[h2]Different hats have different attributes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some change attributes immediately when equipped.
[*] Some provide attribute bonuses while worn.
[*] Some trigger special effects every time you complete a level.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503566/a2d7de713f33b64ffc39eae619f648dc6e2c5703.gif[/img]

[h3]Only one hat can be worn at a time (obviously). Equipping a new hat will replace the current one[/h3]
